notes.title: Trip starts soon - get ready! 🚗
notes.content:
Lately we've been working on a new project, focusing on your feedback and trying to overdo ourselves, and we're almost ready to release it! 

At the end of this week you'll get a chance to get free from your excessively protective and overbearing mother and go on an adventure of a lifetime - jump into the fresh&shiny car that your dad gifted you and set out on a wild trip across the country. 

Explore the world, yourself, hot girls and their bodies - fluid animations, beautiful chicks, fun-to-read story and lots of adult scenes are coming!

Make sure to wishlist the game - this way you won't miss a little surprise we're preparing for the most attentive fans! 

We're eager to see you playing and exploring SEX Route 69! 📍
